description: This file defines the RedisStorageOptions class and related extension methods for configuring Redis storage in Orleans. It includes properties for Redis configuration, serialization, and key generation, as well as a static method for creating Redis connections.

classes.name: RedisStorageOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for Redis-based grain storage in Orleans, including connection settings, serialization, and key generation.

classes.name: RedisStorageOptionsExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring RedisStorageOptions, such as setting key formats.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Internal class used to redact sensitive information from Redis configuration options.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default static method to create a Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously using the provided configuration options.

methods.name: UseGetRedisKeyIgnoringGrainType
methods.description: Extension method to configure Redis storage options to generate keys that ignore the grain type, useful for migration or specific key formatting.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Method to redact sensitive information from ConfigurationOptions, overriding the base Redact method.
